name: Spell Group
description: Defines aura stacking groups: spells assigned to a group via spell_group_spell do not stack with each other according to the group rule. Group ids must be below 64; ids 3 (well fed) and 8 (aura) have hardcoded meaning in the core.

fields.name: Id
fields.help: Group id, must be lower than 64 (stored as a 64 bit mask); 3 = well fed and 8 = aura are hardcoded group ids

fields.name: Rule
fields.help: Unique: only one spell of the group can be active on a target; unique per caster: only one spell of the group per caster
